title: American Based artist C.R. is a force to reckon on
htmlContent:
American music artist C.R. is a talented singer and songwriter raising the bar to become the best in his craft. The poetic genius does not disappoint in releasing his recent track “Everytime I Call You.”

His recent track, “Everytime I Call You,” reflects the universal feeling of longing and unrequited love. In this track, C.R. poured his heart and soul into creating a sound that will captivate his growing fans. C.R. lets his talents shine to the fullest with this song that you can’t keep to yourself but have to show others this fantastic work.
